verses.t: The Inevitable Reality
verses.pickthall: The Reality

verses.t: What is the Inevitable Reality
verses.pickthall: What is the Reality

verses.t: And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality
verses.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the reality is

verses.t: Thamud and 'Aad denied the Striking Calamity
verses.pickthall: (The tribes of) Thamud and A'ad disbelieved in the judgment to come

verses.t: So as for Thamud, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast]
verses.pickthall: As for Thamud, they were destroyed by the lightning

verses.t: And as for 'Aad, they were destroyed by a screaming, violent wind
verses.pickthall: And as for A'ad, they were destroyed by a fierce roaring wind

verses.t: Which Allah imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees
verses.pickthall: Which He imposed on them for seven long nights and eight long days so that thou mightest have seen men lying overthrown, as they were hollow trunks of palm-trees

verses.t: Then do you see of them any remains
verses.pickthall: Canst thou (O Muhammad) see any remnant of them

verses.t: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin
verses.pickthall: And Pharaoh and those before him, and the communities that were destroyed, brought error

verses.t: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity]
verses.pickthall: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, therefor did He grip them with a tightening grip

verses.t: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried your ancestors in the sailing ship
verses.pickthall: Lo! when the waters rose, We carried you upon the ship

verses.t: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it
verses.pickthall: That We might make it a memorial for you, and that remembering ears (that heard the story) might remember

verses.t: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast
verses.pickthall: And when the trumpet shall sound one blast

verses.t: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow
verses.pickthall: And the earth with the mountains shall be lifted up and crushed with one crash

verses.t: Then on that Day, the Resurrection will occur
verses.pickthall: Then, on that day will the Event befall

verses.t: And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm
verses.pickthall: And the heaven will split asunder, for that day it will be frail

verses.t: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them]
verses.pickthall: And the angels will be on the sides thereof, and eight will uphold the Throne of thy Lord that day, above them

verses.t: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed
verses.pickthall: On that day ye will be exposed; not a secret of you will be hidden

verses.t: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record
verses.pickthall: Then, as for him who is given his record in his right hand, he will say: Take, read my book

verses.t: Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account
verses.pickthall: Surely I knew that I should have to meet my reckoning

verses.t: So he will be in a pleasant life
verses.pickthall: Then he will be in blissful state

verses.t: In an elevated garden
verses.pickthall: In a high garden

verses.t: Its [fruit] to be picked hanging near
verses.pickthall: Whereof the clusters are in easy reach

verses.t: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth in the days past
verses.pickthall: (And it will be said unto those therein): Eat and drink at ease for that which ye sent on before you in past days

verses.t: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record
verses.pickthall: But as for him who is given his record in his left hand, he will say: Oh, would that I had not been given my book

verses.t: And had not known what is my account
verses.pickthall: And knew not what my reckoning

verses.t: I wish my death had been the decisive one
verses.pickthall: Oh, would that it had been death

verses.t: My wealth has not availed me
verses.pickthall: My wealth hath not availed me

verses.t: Gone from me is my authority
verses.pickthall: My power hath gone from me

verses.t: [Allah will say], "Seize him and shackle him
verses.pickthall: (It will be said): Take him and fetter him

verses.t: Then into Hellfire drive him
verses.pickthall: And then expose him to hell-fire

verses.t: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him
verses.pickthall: And then insert him in a chain whereof the length is seventy cubits

verses.t: Indeed, he did not used to believe in Allah, the Most Great
verses.pickthall: Lo! He used not to believe in Allah the Tremendous

verses.t: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor
verses.pickthall: And urged not on the feeding of the wretched

verses.t: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend
verses.pickthall: Therefor hath he no lover here this day

verses.t: Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds
verses.pickthall: Nor any food save filth

verses.t: None will eat it except the sinners
verses.pickthall: Which none but sinners eat

verses.t: So I swear by what you see
verses.pickthall: But nay! I swear by all that ye see

verses.t: And what you do not see
verses.pickthall: And all that ye see not

verses.t: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is the word of a noble Messenger
verses.pickthall: That it is indeed the speech of an illustrious messenger

verses.t: And it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe
verses.pickthall: It is not poet's speech - little is it that ye believe

verses.t: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember
verses.pickthall: Nor diviner's speech - little is it that ye remember

verses.t: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds
verses.pickthall: It is a revelation from the Lord of the Worlds

verses.t: And if Muhammad had made up about Us some [false] sayings
verses.pickthall: And if he had invented false sayings concerning Us

verses.t: We would have seized him by the right hand
verses.pickthall: We assuredly had taken him by the right hand

verses.t: Then We would have cut from him the aorta
verses.pickthall: And then severed his life-artery

verses.t: And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him
verses.pickthall: And not one of you could have held Us off from him

verses.t: And indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder for the righteous
verses.pickthall: And lo! it is a warrant unto those who ward off (evil)

verses.t: And indeed, We know that among you are deniers
verses.pickthall: And lo! We know that some among you will deny (it)

verses.t: And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers
verses.pickthall: And lo! it is indeed an anguish for the disbelievers

verses.t: And indeed, it is the truth of certainty
verses.pickthall: And lo! it is absolute truth

verses.t: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great
verses.pickthall: So glorify the name of thy Tremendous Lord
